title: Code of Criminal Procedure Second Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Second Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 371 (Act V of 1898)

CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XV of 2002
(An Ordinance
further to amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 7898)
(Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 14th March, 20021
F. No. 2(I)/2002-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:---
2. Amendment of section 371
(Act V of 1898).---In the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898),
in section 371, in subsection (1), for the proviso the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
Proovided that
this subsection shall not apply to cases tried summarily.
